text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Did I get too much sun in the mountains? 
Or did the campfire dry out the air too 
much...? 
Either way, I need to take proper care of 
it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
All right, first, some dokudami toner— 
Ah, it's running low...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I should brew up the next batch while I 
can. 
Okay, I'll go forage for some right—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...No. If I go outside right now, 
my skin will only get more irritated...
